entries.name: 洪崖洞
entries.prompt: Chongqing Hongyadong eleven-level riverside timber stilt-house complex; curved dark-tile Chinese roofs, interlocking carved wood balcony corridors, realistic warm shop interiors, layered stone footings and hillside access road. Architectural reference accuracy prioritized; no fantasy pagoda blocks or copyrighted signs.

entries.name: 千厮门大桥
entries.prompt: Qiansimen Jialing River Bridge, Chongqing: distinctive single shuttle-shaped cable-stayed pylon, red steel main deck truss, roadway on upper tier and urban rail below, taut cable fan, accurately proportioned piers and supports, realistic metal/concrete PBR materials.

entries.name: 朝天门来福士
entries.prompt: Raffles City Chongqing Chaotianmen: eight sail-shaped glass towers and elevated horizontal Crystal skybridge; eight individually curved slender profiles, realistic facade module mullions, steel and pale concrete podium, accurate urban silhouette and no generic block towers.

entries.name: 李子坝站
entries.prompt: Liziba Chongqing Line 2 urban straddle-beam monorail station occupying middle floors of residential block; genuine facade balconies AC compressors windows, concrete monorail guideway, station glass, realistic compact rail car and surrounding steep green hillside.
